facts.business: VMS Industries Limited is engaged in ship recycling activities at Alang-Sosiya Ship Breaking Yard, processing old ships to produce re-rollable scrap and other recyclable materials such as steel, equipment, and machinery.

auditor.name: S N Shah & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to non-provision for gratuity and other long term employee benefits as per Ind-AS 19; Emphasis of Matter on Note No. 1(g) 2.2 regarding management contention that no employees were eligible for gratuity contribution.

key_risks: Foreign exchange fluctuation risk due to purchase of ships on credit from international market (180-360 days) without hedging
Commodity price risk from fluctuation in iron and steel prices affecting profitability of re-rollable scrap sales
Litigation and tax claims with significant management judgment in assessing exposure (contingent liabilities)
